title: Solace Health: HIPAA deployment review

sentences.speaker: Greg Holt
sentences.text: Patient-adjacent audio cannot touch a shared multi-tenant endpoint. Our counsel was explicit.

sentences.speaker: Luis Ortega
sentences.text: We can sign a BAA today. Dedicated deployment is the open question.

sentences.speaker: Greg Holt
sentences.text: We need a VPC deployment in our own cloud account, with keys we control.

sentences.speaker: Priya Nadar
sentences.text: Without that, I cannot renew in March. I would rather say that now than in February.

sentences.speaker: Sam Ito
sentences.text: A VPC deployment is a big piece of work. Realistically it is a quarter of effort for a squad.

sentences.speaker: Greg Holt
sentences.text: Then it has to start in January for a March fifteenth go-live.

sentences.speaker: Luis Ortega
sentences.text: Noted. I will take the March fifteenth date to product leadership.

summary: Solace Health requires a VPC deployment with BAA for HIPAA workloads, live by 15 March 2027, or will not renew.
action_items: Luis to escalate 15 Mar 2027 VPC date to product leadership
Sam to draft VPC reference architecture
